_comment: Offline fallback for the server's tracked set. REAL, UNMODIFIED TLEs.
Used only when CelesTrak cannot be reached, so the console still has a
genuine set to track and screen with no network at all.
This seed holds only the 4 objects that were already committed in
frontend/src/lib/tleSnapshot.js. It is enough to prove the fallback
works and NOT enough to produce a populated event list -- replace it
with a debris-rich set from the refresh script before the demo.
